title: Accuracy and Reliability of Large Language Models in Cosmetic Chemistry and Skin Health: A Benchmarking Study
abstract: arXiv:2608.14631v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As consumers increasingly turn to AI chatbots for skincare advice, the technical accuracy of Large Language Models (LLMs) in cosmetic chemistry remains largely under-evaluated. We benchmarked 14 LLMs on a structured set of topics related to cosmetic chemistry, including the chemical properties of specific cosmetic ingredients and common cosmetic scenarios that may be of interest to consumers. Web search was disabled throughout to assess each model's internalized knowledge rather than its internet retrieval capacity. Overall performance was poor, with the most pronounced deficits in quantitative reasoning and structural identification tasks. While models handled general skincare questions with reasonability, responses consistently lacked the technical depth required for informed consumer decision-making. Notably, conversation with AI can pose a risk: outputs that sound authoritative but contain technical errors are less likely to generate

translated_title: 大型语言模型在化妆品化学与皮肤健康中的准确性与可靠性：一项基准测试研究
translated_abstract: 摘要：随着消费者越来越多地转向AI聊天机器人寻求护肤建议，大型语言模型（LLMs）在化妆品化学领域的技术准确性在很大程度上仍未得到充分评估。我们在与化妆品化学相关的结构化主题集上对14个LLM进行了基准测试，这些主题包括特定化妆品成分的化学性质以及消费者可能感兴趣的常见化妆品场景。整个过程中禁用了网络搜索，以评估每个模型的内化知识，而非其互联网检索能力。总体表现不佳，最显著的缺陷出现在定量推理和结构识别任务中。虽然模型在处理一般性护肤问题时表现合理，但回答始终缺乏为消费者做出明智决策所需的技术深度。值得注意的是，与AI的对话可能带来风险：听起来权威但包含技术错误的输出不太可能引起质疑。
tldr: 本研究对14个大型语言模型在化妆品化学领域进行了基准测试，发现其总体表现不佳，尤其在定量推理和结构识别方面存在显著缺陷，且技术深度不足，可能误导消费者。
en_tdlr: This study benchmarks 14 LLMs in cosmetic chemistry, finding poor overall performance with notable deficits in quantitative reasoning and structural identification, and insufficient technical depth that may mislead consumers.
